gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-slabo-13px: A splayed c terminal and a tube-like stroke give Tilt Neon its glowing, sign-painter punch. Slabo 13px follows as a classic serif with tall, open a, e and s, so paragraphs stay dignified and easy on the eye.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum reads like a text serif cut from squared-off woodblock, high in the x-height and wide in the c. Tilt Neon above it keeps one engraver's depth of line throughout, so a long page feels sturdy but never heavy.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-hepta-slab: Turret Road draws its round forms like open parentheses, in a pen-like line. Hepta Slab below stretches each word out, its counters breathing, and that wide, bookish ease is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru reads like a text serif with generous letterspace, its terminals stopping well short of the stem and its o a clean ring. Turret Road's parenthesis curves are the strongest part.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Padyakke Expanded One spreads wide and slow. Its serif glyphs hang apart like knots on a slack rope, and each round bowl keeps a uniform wall, so a long stretch reads literary, deliberate and unhurried beside Underdog's horseshoe c.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Stint Ultra Expanded reads with each character floating apart, like pipe cleaner bent into a text serif. Give it a size a notch above usual, since those open counters and wide gaps need room to breathe under Underdog.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-epunda-slab: Big lowercase, bright counters. Unica One keeps every stroke at one thickness, while Epunda Slab, a classic serif, gapes open in its c and rises tall and round.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One sits low and literary. Its tall middle band, shallow ascenders and welcoming e make a serif body that pairs with Unica One's single-width pen line, and that quiet gap in weight is the strongest quality.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-glegoo: Unica One has a signage-like plainness, with its n arch and stem matching in weight. And Glegoo, a text serif with big counters and wide-mouthed curves, gives the page a softer, more editorial voice beneath it.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-hanuman: Unica One sets a signage-like plainness in every line, with a very large lowercase eye and daylight in each curve. And Hanuman, a text serif with a high-waisted lowercase, carries paragraphs in a traditional, refined way.
